pages.text: $(o)A storm-crowned terror ruling the $(l)Acropolis$(), high above the warm seas.$()$(br2)$(l)Counter:$() She strikes in wide sweeping arcs and calls lightning. Step out of reach, then close in when the sweep ends.$(br2)No quest asks for her. Go for the loot and the story.
$(l)Defeated.$()$(br2)Fallen. The warm seas are a little quieter.
